text:
Talia: Quick proposal 1-week blast to test tiered starter credits + webinar invite as an activation nudging tactic. Hypothesis: higher credit + webinar CTA increases Day-3 activation and webinar sign-ups.

Rohit: Sounds good. Who's in scope? New orgs only? Email vs OAuth signups?

Talia: New orgs created during window only. All signup methods. We'll exclude internal & test accounts. Target sample ~8k new orgs (split below). Primary metrics: pct_activated_d3 (>=2 API calls), webinar_reg_rate, median_tokens_first_week.

Jun: Proposed arms: control (no credits, baseline messaging), low-credit (25 tokens + soft CTA), high-credit (100 tokens + strong webinar CTA + one-click calendar add). Also track which CTA variant (copy A/B).

Priya: For the webinar CTA let's make two micro-variations: "Live quickstart: 30m" vs "On-demand short walkthrough". We'll run CTA copy A/B within the high-credit arm.

Talia: Allocation: control 50%, low-credit 25%, high-credit 25% (high-credit split 50/50 for CTA A/B). Start: 2026-04-06T14:00Z, duration 7d. Rollout ramp 3h.

Rohit: Tracking - we need these events: signup.org_id, experiment.micro_tiered_credits, variant_name, cta_variant, webinar_click, webinar_reg, api_call_count. Add UTM tags for all outbound links: ?utm_medium=product&utm_campaign=starter_tier_test.

devops-bot: Flag request received: micro_tiered_credits_v1. Scheduling rollout window.

eng-bot: Feature flags created: micro_tiered_credits_v1=25% (low), 25% (high)
